title: 2019 KPHC durable wall material by county — derived from Table 2.13

title: KENPHIA 2018 final report — county HIV prevalence, ages 15–64

title: 2023 health facilities assessed per 10,000 projected residents
release_notes: Formula: facilities_assessed / projected_population_2023 * 10000. Numerator: MoH Health Facility Census 2023 Table 2. Denominator: KNBS Gross County Product 2024 Table 1 projected 2023 population.

title: County Government pending bills — FY 2024/25 close
release_notes: Table 10: County Governments Pending Bills as at 30th June 2025. Source of data: Controller of Budget. 46 numeric county totals; Narok official non-submission. The 46 displayed one-decimal county totals sum to 176,904.5 million while the publication reports the national total as 176,904.2 million. The Atlas preserves every published county row and the published national total rather than altering a county to force arithmetic equality.

title: 2023/24 KHS improved drinking-water source by county — Table 5.14
release_notes: 2023/24 Kenya Housing Survey Basic Report; Table 5.14 — Percentage Distribution of Households by Access to Main Source of Drinking Water. The value is the published improved-source subtotal for each county. Publication date is stored at month precision as documented in the source snapshot; no lower-level or parent-geography inheritance.

title: SARA Table 18 inpatient-service availability by county
release_notes: Service Availability and Readiness Assessment (SARA) Main Report; Table 18 — Percentage of facilities with Inpatient Facilities. Values are direct county percentages with published facility denominators. The dated report snapshot is used as the release vintage because Table 18 does not state a separate table-specific observation date.

title: KDHS 2022 Table 2.21.3C cash transfer/social assistance by county
release_notes: Kenya Demographic and Health Survey 2022: Volume 1; Table 2.21.3C — Cash transfer or social assistance by county. Direct household survey percentages for all 47 counties with published household denominators. The administrative Inua Jamii count concept is not inferred from this table.

title: 2019 KPHC Table 2.36 motorcycle and car ownership by county
release_notes: 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census, Volume IV: Distribution of Population by Socio-Economic Characteristics; Table 2.36 — Percentage Distribution of Conventional Households by Ownership of Selected Household Assets by Area of Residence, County and Sub County. Direct county motorcycle and car ownership percentages. Peer-reviewed PLOS ONE Table 1 independently reproduces the same 47-county columns from the KPHC. No combined vehicle share is created.
